purpose: Observe simultaneous gate states on frozen same-scan inputs without changing fail-fast Formal behavior.

states.PASS: All required same-scan evidence is present and the frozen gate condition passes.
states.FAIL: All required same-scan evidence is present and the frozen gate condition fails.
states.UNKNOWN: Required evidence/provenance is missing or incomplete; never coerce to FAIL.
states.NOT_EVALUABLE: A conditional gate has no valid prerequisite state, e.g. RR when no target/channel exists.

design.formulas: Observer consumes exact derived values from the decision path where possible rather than rebuilding a second scoring engine.

durableSnapshotAudit.conclusion: Existing durable snapshot alone is insufficient for full gate-overlap inference; missing fields remain CAPTURE_GAP/UNKNOWN.

implementationBoundary.classA: Pure in-memory/offline observer + deterministic tests; zero new market calls; no Formal dependency.
implementationBoundary.classB: Persisting complete overlap receipts, earlier universe/history-admission receipts, immutable generation linkage or shared runtime schema.

prohibited: Using FAIL counts as marginal gate contribution
Changing Formal result from observer output
Treating legacy targetState NONE as TARGET_NONE_SEARCH_COMPLETE without explicit source/provenance and search-completeness evidence
Using targetSemanticsV2 to alter Formal RR, target, admission or ranking
Choosing an alternative RR/target method after observing outcomes

states.TARGET_FOUND: Verified source/provenance plus verified geometry and finite target.
states.TARGET_NONE_SEARCH_COMPLETE: Verified source/provenance plus explicit complete search and verified geometry with no qualifying resistance.
states.TARGET_UNKNOWN_SOURCE: Target source/provenance is not verified; never coerce to NONE.
states.TARGET_UNKNOWN_GEOMETRY: Source may exist but search completeness/geometry is not verified or state cannot be resolved.

targetSemanticsV2.policy: Existing TARGET_AVAILABLE PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN remains unchanged. Four-state semantics is a parallel research interpretation only.
